prompt: Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Air Squat with correct form. Key points: Stand shoulder-width apart with toes turned out slightly; Send the hips back and bend the knees at the same time while keeping the chest tall; Lower until the thighs reach knee height or your comfortable depth, with knees tracking over the toes; Push the floor away through the whole foot and stand up without forcing the knees to lock. Avoid: Knees caving inward on the way up; Heels lifting off the floor; Rounding the lower back at the bottom.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Barbell Back Squat with correct form. Key points: Set the bar in the rack at upper-chest height and get under it with the bar resting on the upper traps; Walk back in small steps and stand shoulder-width apart with toes turned out slightly; Inhale, brace the abs and lower under control with knees tracking the toes, to at least parallel; Drive through the whole foot and rise with a neutral back to full standing, exhaling near the top. Avoid: Rounding the lower back at the bottom; Hips shooting up first while the chest drops; Knees caving inward.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Barbell Bench Press with correct form. Key points: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar, feet planted and shoulder blades pulled together; Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders and unrack it with straight arms; Lower the bar under control to the lower chest with elbows at about 45 to 70 degrees from the body; Press the bar up in a slight arc toward the shoulders until the arms are straight; Rack the bar when done instead of resting it on the chest. Avoid: Lifting the glutes off the bench; Bouncing the bar off the chest; Letting the wrists bend back under the bar.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Barbell Curl with correct form. Key points: Stand tall holding a barbell with an underhand grip at shoulder width, arms straight and elbows near the body; Brace abs and glutes with the knees slightly soft; Bend the elbows and curl the bar toward the chest without moving the shoulders; Squeeze the biceps at the top and lower the bar under control to full extension. Avoid: Arching the lower back and swinging the weight up; Cocking the wrists back during the lift; Dropping the bar fast and skipping the lowering phase.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Barbell Hip Thrust with correct form. Key points: Sit on the floor with the lower shoulder blades on a stable bench and roll the padded bar over the hip crease; Plant the feet flat, hip-width apart, and hold the bar with both hands; Tuck the chin and drive through the heels to lift the hips to a straight line; Pause for a second at the top with ribs down, then lower slowly until the hips almost touch the floor. Avoid: Over-arching the lower back at the top; Bar without padding digging into the hip bones; Lifting the heels and pushing from the toes.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Bent-Over Barbell Row with correct form. Key points: Stand hip-width apart, grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders and lift it from the rack or floor; Push the hips back and hinge until the torso is almost parallel to the floor, with a flat back and soft knees; Pull the bar toward the lower belly while squeezing the shoulder blades together; Pause briefly at the top, then lower the bar under control to straight arms without changing torso angle. Avoid: Rounding the lower back or standing up each rep to cheat the pull; Pulling with the arms only without moving the shoulder blades; Using a load so heavy that the torso swings.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Bent-Over Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly with correct form. Key points: Stand hip-width and hinge forward at the hips until the torso is nearly parallel to the floor; Let the dumbbells hang under the shoulders with the elbows slightly bent and a flat back; Raise the dumbbells out to the sides in an arc, squeezing the shoulder blades, until the arms are at back height; Lower slowly to the start without rocking the torso. Avoid: Rounding the lower and upper back; Using torso momentum; Raising above back height while tensing the neck.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Bird Dog with correct form. Key points: Get on all fours with shoulders over the hands, hips over the knees and a neutral spine; Lightly brace the abs and push the floor away through the palms; Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back together until you form a line from fingertips to heel; Pause for a second without shifting the hips or shoulders, then return slowly; Switch sides and continue alternating. Avoid: Arching the lower back as the leg lifts; Rotating the pelvis and leaning to one side; Rushing through with no pause.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Bulgarian Split Squat with correct form. Key points: Stand about 60 cm in front of a bench and rest the top of the back foot on it; Keep the front foot planted, torso slightly forward but tall, eyes ahead; Lower the back knee straight down until the front thigh is nearly parallel to the floor; Drive through the whole front foot back up, and finish the set before switching legs. Avoid: Standing too close to the bench, pushing the knee forward; Pushing hard from the back leg; Front knee caving inward.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Burpee with correct form. Key points: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and squat until the hands touch the floor; Jump or step the feet back into a high plank with the body in a straight line; Lower the chest to the floor in a push-up and press back up; Jump or step the feet to the hands and settle into the squat; Jump up with the arms overhead and land softly on the whole foot. Avoid: Letting the hips sag in the plank and push-up; Jumping with locked knees; Collapsing the lower back on the landing.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Cable Fly with correct form. Key points: Set the cables at shoulder height, grab the handles and step forward into a split stance; Lean the torso slightly forward, keep the elbows slightly bent and start with the arms open to the sides; Sweep the arms forward in an arc until the hands meet in front of the chest; Squeeze the chest briefly and return slowly to the open position with a comfortable stretch. Avoid: Bending and straightening the elbows so it turns into a press; Opening so wide that the shoulder is pulled forward; Swinging the body instead of controlling the arms.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Rope Triceps Pushdown with correct form. Key points: Attach a rope to the high pulley and stand close with soft knees and the torso leaning slightly forward; Hold the rope ends and pin the elbows to the ribs with the forearms at about 90 degrees; Extend the elbows to push the rope down, and at the bottom spread the rope ends apart and squeeze the triceps; Return under control to about 90 degrees without lifting the elbows from the ribs. Avoid: Letting the elbows drift and turning it into a body-weight push; Using a load so heavy that the shoulders swing.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Cat-Cow with correct form. Key points: Start on all fours with shoulders over the wrists and hips over the knees; Inhale and let the belly sink toward the floor while the tailbone and gaze lift (cow); Exhale and round the whole spine toward the ceiling, release the head and tuck the pelvis (cat); Flow between the two positions slowly, one movement per breath. Avoid: Moving fast and jerkily without reaching the full range; Moving only the neck and lower back while the mid-back stays still.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Chin-Up with correct form. Key points: Grip the bar underhand, palms facing you, at shoulder width; Hang with straight arms, draw the shoulder blades down and brace the abs; Pull the elbows down and forward until the chin clears the bar; Lower the body slowly to almost straight arms. Avoid: Reaching the chin forward with the neck to clear the bar; Hard elbow lockout with a bounce at the bottom.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Conventional Deadlift with correct form. Key points: Stand with the bar over mid-foot, feet hip-width apart, and bend down to grip the bar at shoulder width; Drop the hips until the shins touch the bar, open the chest and set a flat back; Take a deep belly breath, brace the abs and push the floor away as the bar rises close to the shins; Lock out knees and hips together at the top, then lower the bar under control along the same path. Avoid: Rounding the lower back off the floor; Hips rising before the chest and the bar drifting away; Pulling with the arms instead of pushing with the legs; Over-extending the back at lockout.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Crunch with correct form. Key points: Lie on the back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor; Rest the fingertips lightly beside the temples or cross the arms on the chest without pulling on the head; Exhale and lift the shoulders and upper back off the floor by contracting the abs; Pause briefly at the top while the lower back stays on the floor; Lower slowly back to the start without dropping the head. Avoid: Pulling the head and neck forward with the hands; Using momentum instead of control; Lifting the whole back off the floor, which turns it into a sit-up.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Dead Bug with correct form. Key points: Lie on the back with arms straight up toward the ceiling and knees bent at 90 degrees over the hips; Press the lower back into the floor and brace the abs; Reach one arm overhead and the opposite leg out toward the floor without losing the flat back; Return to the start and switch sides, breathing steadily throughout. Avoid: Arching the lower back when the leg lowers too far; Moving fast at the expense of control; Holding the breath during the movement.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Dead Hang with correct form. Key points: Grip the bar overhand at shoulder width with the thumbs wrapped around it; Lift the feet off the floor or box and let the body hang with straight arms; Relax the shoulders for a passive hang, or lightly pull the shoulder blades down for an active hang; Hold for 20 to 40 seconds while breathing calmly; Step down to the floor or box with control instead of dropping off with locked arms. Avoid: Swinging the body back and forth; Fully relaxing the shoulders when the joint is painful or unstable.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Diamond Push-Up with correct form. Key points: Start in a high plank and bring thumbs and index fingers together under the chest in a diamond shape; Brace abs and glutes so the body forms a straight line from head to heels; Lower the chest toward the hands under control with the elbows travelling back and close to the ribs; Press the floor away back to straight arms without locking the elbows. Avoid: Placing the diamond too far forward and overloading the shoulders; Sagging hips and arching the lower back.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Dumbbell Bench Press with correct form. Key points: Sit on the bench with a dumbbell on each thigh and lie back, bringing the weights up to chest level; Pinch the shoulder blades together, keep the feet planted and press the dumbbells over the chest with straight arms; Lower the dumbbells under control to the sides of the chest with elbows at about 45 to 70 degrees from the body; Press the dumbbells up in a slight arc until they almost meet above the chest. Avoid: Letting the dumbbells drift too far out at the bottom; Lifting the glutes off the bench; Letting the wrists bend back.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Dumbbell Biceps Curl with correct form. Key points: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward and elbows pinned to the ribs; Brace the abs and set the shoulder blades slightly back; Bend one elbow and curl the dumbbell toward the shoulder without letting the elbow drift forward; Pause briefly at the top squeeze, then lower over about three seconds to an almost straight arm; Repeat, alternating arms. Avoid: Swinging the torso back to cheat a weight that is too heavy; Letting the elbow travel forward so the shoulder takes over; Stopping short of a full elbow extension at the bottom.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Dumbbell Lateral Raise with correct form. Key points: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at the sides, palms facing in and elbows slightly bent; Brace the abs and keep the shoulders away from the ears; Raise the dumbbells out to the sides in an arc to shoulder height, with the elbows leading the hands slightly; Pause briefly at the top and lower slowly with control, without resting the weights on the thighs. Avoid: Swinging the torso to lift a weight that is too heavy; Raising above shoulder height while shrugging; Raising the arms forward instead of out to the sides.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Cable Face Pull with correct form. Key points: Set a rope on a cable at face height or slightly above and hold both ends with palms facing each other; Step back until the cable is taut, feet hip-width and knees slightly bent; Pull the rope toward the face with high elbows flaring out, ends splitting past the ears; Pause, squeeze the shoulder blades and return slowly to straight arms. Avoid: Using so much weight that you lean back; Letting the elbows drop low; Pulling to chest level instead of the face.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Farmer Carry with correct form. Key points: Stand between two dumbbells and hinge down with a flat back to take a firm grip on both; Stand tall by driving the floor away with the legs while pulling the shoulders back and down; Walk with medium, even steps, abs braced and eyes forward; Stop at the end of the distance or time and set the dumbbells down under control. Avoid: Leaning the torso to one side; Taking long, bouncy steps; Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Forearm Plank with correct form. Key points: Place the forearms on the floor with elbows directly under the shoulders and hands parallel; Lift the body onto the toes with legs straight and close together; Brace the abs and glutes so the body forms a straight line from head to heels; Hold the position with normal breathing, looking at the floor with the neck neutral. Avoid: Sagging the hips and lower back toward the floor; Piking the hips too high to make it easier; Lifting or dropping the head and breaking the neck line; Holding the breath throughout the hold.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Glute Bridge with correct form. Key points: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart; Rest the arms at your sides and bring the heels close to the glutes; Brace the abs, squeeze the glutes and drive through the heels to lift the hips; Pause for a second with a straight line from knees to shoulders; Lower the hips slowly until they lightly touch the floor, then repeat. Avoid: Over-arching the lower back instead of lifting with the glutes; Knees collapsing inward during the push; Pushing through the toes instead of the heels.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Dumbbell Goblet Squat with correct form. Key points: Hold a dumbbell vertically with both hands against the chest and elbows pointing down; Stand shoulder-width apart or slightly wider with toes turned out slightly; Lower under control between the knees as the elbows slide inside the thighs, keeping the chest tall; Drive through the whole foot back to standing without losing the dumbbell position. Avoid: Torso pitching forward as the dumbbell drifts away from the chest; Heels lifting; Knees caving inward on the way up.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Hammer Curl with correct form. Key points: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other as if holding a hammer; Pin the elbows to the ribs and brace the abs; Bend one elbow and curl the dumbbell toward the shoulder with the thumb pointing up; Lower under control and repeat on the other side. Avoid: Rotating the wrist during the rep; Swinging with the body and hips; Shrugging the shoulder toward the ear.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing High Plank with correct form. Key points: Place the palms on the floor directly under the shoulders with arms straight; Lift the body onto the toes with legs straight and close together; Brace the abs and glutes so the body forms a straight line from head to heels; Push the floor away with the palms to spread the shoulder blades apart, and hold with normal breathing. Avoid: Sagging the hips and arching the lower back; Sinking between the shoulder blades with the chest collapsing toward the floor; Locking the elbows into hyperextension.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Incline Dumbbell Press with correct form. Key points: Set the bench to 30 to 45 degrees and sit with a dumbbell on each thigh; Lie back, pinch the shoulder blades and bring the dumbbells to upper-chest height; Lower the dumbbells under control to the sides of the chest with elbows at about 45 to 70 degrees from the body; Press the dumbbells up in a slight arc to straight arms over the shoulders. Avoid: An angle so steep it becomes a shoulder press; Going too deep with the shoulders rolling forward; Swinging the body for momentum.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Incline Push-Up with correct form. Key points: Place the hands on a stable surface such as a bench, table or railing, slightly wider than shoulders; Step back until the body forms a straight line from head to heels and brace abs and glutes; Lower the chest toward the surface with elbows at about 45 degrees from the body; Push the surface away to straight arms. The lower the surface, the harder the move. Avoid: Using an unstable surface that moves during the push; Sagging or hinging at the hips; Poking the head forward instead of lowering the chest.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Inverted Row with correct form. Key points: Pick a sturdy bar at about waist height (low bar, rack or bar in a rack), lie underneath it and grip slightly wider than shoulders; Lift the body into a straight line from head to heels with arms straight; Pull the chest to the bar while squeezing the shoulder blades together and keeping abs and glutes tight; Lower the body under control to straight arms without letting the hips sag. Avoid: Sagging hips during the pull; Poking the chin forward without moving the torso; Partial reps that never reach the full range.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Jumping Jacks with correct form. Key points: Stand tall with feet together and arms at the sides; Hop lightly, spreading the feet wide while raising the arms overhead; Hop back to feet together and lower the arms to the sides; Keep a steady rhythm with soft landings on the feet and slightly bent knees. Avoid: Landing on the heels with locked knees; Arching the lower back as the arms rise.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Kettlebell Swing with correct form. Key points: Stand with feet slightly wider than the shoulders and a kettlebell on the floor a few centimeters in front; Push the hips back, grip the bell with both hands with a flat back and hike it back between the legs; Snap the hips and glutes forward quickly so the bell floats forward to chest height; Let the bell fall back, push the hips back and guide it between the legs for the next rep. Avoid: Squatting instead of pushing the hips back; Lifting the bell with the shoulders; Arching the lower back at the top.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown with correct form. Key points: Sit at the machine with thighs under the pad and grip the bar overhand about 1.5 times shoulder width; Lean back slightly with the chest open and draw the shoulder blades down before pulling; Pull the bar to the upper chest by driving the elbows down and out; Pause for one second and squeeze the lats without swinging the torso; Return the bar up slowly until the arms are straight and the shoulder blades stretch under control. Avoid: Pulling the bar behind the neck; Rocking the torso back to move a heavy weight.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Leg Press with correct form. Key points: Sit in the machine with back and hips flat against the pad and feet shoulder-width apart on the platform; Release the safety catches and lower the platform under control until the knees reach about 90 degrees; Keep the hips pressed to the pad and do not let the lower back round at the bottom; Press through the whole foot to almost full extension without forcing the knees to lock. Avoid: Lowering so deep the hips lift and the back rounds; Locking the knees at the top; Feet too low on the platform, overloading the knees.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Lying Leg Curl Machine with correct form. Key points: Lie face down on the machine with knees just past the edge of the bench and the pad on the lower calves; Hold the handles and press the hips into the bench; Curl the heels toward the glutes while squeezing the hamstrings; Pause briefly and lower the weight slowly to almost straight legs. Avoid: Lifting the hips off the bench and arching the lower back; Using too much weight and swinging; Dropping the weight quickly.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Machine Chest Press with correct form. Key points: Adjust the seat so the handles are at mid-chest height and sit with the back against the pad; Grip the handles with straight wrists and pull the shoulder blades back; Press the handles forward to nearly straight arms without locking the elbows; Return slowly until the elbows are just behind the body line while keeping tension in the chest. Avoid: A seat set too low or too high that overloads the shoulders; Shrugging the shoulders to the ears; Letting the weight stack drop freely.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Machine Shoulder Press with correct form. Key points: Adjust the seat so the handles are at shoulder height and rest the back against the pad; Grip the handles with elbows under the wrists and feet planted on the floor; Press the handles up until the elbows are almost fully straight; Lower slowly until the elbows are about shoulder height and repeat without dropping the weight. Avoid: Arching the lower back and lifting the hips off the seat; Hard locking the elbows at the top; Dropping the weight on the way down.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Mountain Climbers with correct form. Key points: Start in a high plank with hands under the shoulders and the body in a straight line; Bring one knee toward the chest without lifting the hips; Switch legs with a light hop and keep alternating at a steady pace; Keep the abs braced and breathe continuously through the set. Avoid: Piking the hips up into a pyramid shape; Taking tiny steps without driving the knee toward the chest.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing One-Arm Dumbbell Row with correct form. Key points: Place one knee and hand on a bench with the other foot on the floor and a flat, near-parallel back; Grip the dumbbell with the free hand, arm straight under the shoulder; Pull the dumbbell toward the hip while drawing the shoulder blade toward the spine; Lower under control to a light stretch in the back, finish all reps, then switch sides. Avoid: Rotating the torso upward during the pull; Pulling too high toward the shoulder instead of the hip; Dropping the weight quickly without control.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Cable Pallof Press with correct form. Key points: Set the cable at chest height and stand sideways to it with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent; Hold the handle with both hands in front of the chest, elbows tucked; Press the handle straight forward until the arms are straight, without letting the cable rotate you; Hold for a second or two, then return the handle to the chest with control; Finish the reps and switch sides. Avoid: Rotating the torso toward the cable; Leaning back to compensate for the weight; Choosing a load so heavy it breaks form.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Parallel-Bar Dip with correct form. Key points: Grip the parallel bars and press up to straight arms, with the shoulders pushed down and away from the ears; Keep the torso upright with the legs crossed behind and the chest open; Lower under control by bending the elbows back, keeping them close to the ribs; Stop when the shoulders are about level with the elbows, and do not go deeper; Press through the palms back to straight arms. Avoid: Dropping too deep with the shoulders rolling forward; Swinging the body and bouncing at the bottom.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Pike Push-Up with correct form. Key points: Start in a pike with hips high, hands shoulder-width apart and legs nearly straight; Bend the elbows and lower the head diagonally toward the floor between the hands; Stop when the head is close to the floor, with the elbows about 45 degrees from the body; Press the floor away back to straight arms while keeping the hips high. Avoid: Flaring the elbows out; Dropping the hips so it becomes a regular push-up; Dropping onto the forehead without control.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Pull-Up with correct form. Key points: Grip the bar overhand slightly wider than the shoulders and hang with straight arms; Draw the shoulder blades down, brace the abs and keep the legs together; Pull the elbows down and toward the ribs until the chin clears the bar; Pause briefly at the top and lower slowly to straight arms. Avoid: Kicking and swinging instead of a controlled pull; Partial reps without reaching straight arms at the bottom.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Push-Up with correct form. Key points: Start in a high plank with hands slightly wider than shoulders; Brace abs and glutes so the body forms a straight line from head to heels; Lower the chest toward the floor with elbows at about 45 degrees from the body; Press the floor away back to straight arms without locking the elbows. Avoid: Sagging hips or piking the glutes; Flaring elbows out to 90 degrees.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Reverse Lunge with correct form. Key points: Stand tall hips-width apart with hands on the hips or in front of the chest; Step far back, land on the ball of the foot and lower the back knee toward the floor; Stop when the front thigh is nearly parallel with the front knee over the ankle; Drive through the front heel back to standing, then repeat with the other leg. Avoid: Taking too short a step back; Landing on the heel of the back foot; Leaning forward and dumping weight onto the front knee.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Romanian Deadlift with correct form. Key points: Hold the bar with an overhand grip at shoulder width and stand tall with the bar at the thighs, knees slightly bent; Tighten the lats and push the hips back as the bar slides down the thighs and shins; Keep lowering until a strong hamstring stretch, with a flat back and the bar close to the body; Drive the hips forward with the glutes to stand tall, without leaning back at the top. Avoid: Rounding the lower back as the bar passes the knees; Letting the bar drift away from the body; Leaning back at lockout.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Russian Twist with correct form. Key points: Sit on the floor, bend the knees and lean back until the torso is tilted about 45 degrees; Clasp the hands together in front of the chest and lift the heels slightly if possible; Rotate the ribcage to one side so the hands travel beside the body; Return through the center and rotate to the other side, driving the motion from the ribs and not only the arms; Keep a long spine and an open chest through the whole set. Avoid: Rounding the lower back and collapsing backward; Swinging the arms fast with no real trunk rotation; Using momentum so control is lost.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Seated Cable Row with correct form. Key points: Sit facing the cable station with feet on the footplate, knees soft and back straight; Hold the handle and start with straight arms and shoulder blades slightly protracted; Pull the handle to the lower belly while squeezing the shoulder blades together, without leaning back; Return the handle slowly to straight arms and stay in control the whole way. Avoid: Rocking the torso back and forth every rep; Rounding the back at the stretched end of the range; Pulling with raised shoulders.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press with correct form. Key points: Set a bench nearly upright and sit with the back supported and feet planted; Bring the dumbbells to shoulder height with palms forward and the elbows slightly in front of the body line; Brace the abs and press the dumbbells overhead to almost full extension; Lower slowly until the dumbbells are about ear height and continue without hard locking the elbows. Avoid: Arching the lower back and lifting the glutes; A shallow descent that cuts the range; Hard locking the elbows at the top.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Side Plank with correct form. Key points: Lie on one side with the elbow directly under the shoulder and the forearm square to the mat edge; Stack the feet, or place the top foot in front for extra stability; Lift the hips off the floor until the body forms a straight line from head to ankles; Brace the abs and glutes, push the shoulder away from the ear and keep breathing steadily; Hold for the target time, lower with control, then switch sides. Avoid: Letting the hips sag toward the floor; Rolling the chest forward or backward out of the plane; Sinking into the shoulder instead of pushing the floor away.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Split Squat with correct form. Key points: Take a long staggered stance with one foot forward and one back, hips-width apart side to side; Lift the back heel and stay on the ball of the back foot with the torso upright; Lower the back knee straight down toward the floor until the front thigh is nearly parallel; Drive through the whole front foot back up without shifting forward or back, then switch legs. Avoid: Stance too short, pushing the front knee far forward; Leaning the torso forward; Front knee wobbling inward.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Standing Barbell Overhead Press with correct form. Key points: Set the bar at chin height and unrack it with hands slightly wider than the shoulders and the bar resting on the front delts; Stand hip-width, squeeze the glutes and abs, and move the elbows slightly forward; Press the bar straight up, moving the head slightly back and then forward under the bar; Finish with arms locked overhead and the bar over mid-foot, then lower under control back to the shoulders. Avoid: Arching the lower back to drive the bar up; Not moving the head through at the top, so the bar finishes in front of the shoulders; Pressing the bar forward instead of straight up.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Standing Calf Raise with correct form. Key points: Stand hip-width apart, near a wall or rail for balance, with weight spread across the feet; Rise as high as possible onto the balls of the feet without letting the ankles roll outward; Pause for a second at the top and squeeze the calves; Lower the heels slowly to a light stretch at the bottom. Avoid: Bouncing off the ankles; Ankles rolling outward; Short range without a full lowering.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing World Greatest Stretch with correct form. Key points: Step into a long lunge and place both hands on the floor inside the front foot; Sink the hips forward and down, keeping the back leg straight and the spine long; Lift the hand nearest the front leg and rotate the chest toward the ceiling, eyes following the hand; Return the hand to the floor, sit back and straighten the front leg to stretch the hamstring; Come forward again, finish the repetitions and switch legs. Avoid: Taking too short a step, which blocks the hip opening; Rotating from the lower back instead of the rib cage.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Arnold Press with correct form. Key points: Sit on an upright bench with dumbbells in front of the shoulders, palms facing the body and elbows under the hands; Begin pressing up while rotating the palms outward at the same time; Finish overhead with palms facing forward and the arms nearly straight; Lower with control while rotating the palms back in, in front of the shoulders. Avoid: A weight too heavy to rotate properly; Arching the back to press; Rotating fast so the motion becomes jerky.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Band-Assisted Pull-Up with correct form. Key points: Loop a strong band around the bar and place a knee or foot in it; Grip the bar overhand at shoulder width and hang with straight arms; Draw the shoulder blades down and pull the elbows down until the chin clears the bar; Lower the body slowly to straight arms without bouncing out of the band. Avoid: Staying on a very thick band too long instead of reducing the assistance gradually; Bouncing out of the bottom.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Resistance Band Chest Press with correct form. Key points: Anchor the band behind you at chest height, grip the ends and step forward until there is light tension; Stand in a split stance with the elbows bent at chest height, about 45 degrees from the body; Press the hands forward to nearly straight arms without locking the elbows; Return slowly to the start while keeping tension in the band. Avoid: Shoulders creeping up toward the ears; An unstable anchor; Leaning back to fight the band.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Resistance Band Curl with correct form. Key points: Stand on the middle of the band with feet shoulder-width apart and grip both ends underhand; Pin the elbows to the ribs and brace the abs; Bend the elbows and stretch the band toward the shoulders; Lower slowly and keep some tension in the band even at the bottom. Avoid: Letting the elbows drift forward; Releasing the band all at once; Using a frayed or cracked band.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Band External Rotation with correct form. Key points: Anchor a band at waist height and stand beside it, holding the end with the hand farthest from the anchor; Bend the elbow 90 degrees and pin it to the ribs, with a small folded towel between the elbow and body; Rotate the forearm outward away from the belly without moving the elbow off the body; Return slowly with control and finish all reps before switching arms. Avoid: Letting the elbow drift away from the body; Rotating the torso instead of the shoulder; Using a band so strong that control is lost.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Band Lat Pulldown with correct form. Key points: Anchor a band high and secure, kneel on one or both knees and hold the ends with straight arms overhead; Draw the shoulder blades down and lean back slightly with the chest open; Pull the elbows down and out until the hands reach upper chest height; Pause for one second and feel the lats squeeze; Slowly return the hands overhead and keep tension on the band. Avoid: Leaning back too far and pulling with the lower back; Letting the band snap back up quickly.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Band Pull-Apart with correct form. Key points: Stand tall holding a band with both hands in front of the chest at shoulder height and shoulder width; Brace the abs lightly and keep the elbows nearly straight; Pull the band apart until it touches the chest, squeezing the shoulder blades together; Return slowly to the start without losing tension in the band. Avoid: Shrugging toward the ears; Leaning back to finish the rep; Letting the band snap back quickly.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Resistance Band Row with correct form. Key points: Sit on the floor with legs straight, loop the band around the feet and hold both ends; Sit tall with a straight back and open chest, arms straight and the band lightly taut; Pull the hands to the lower belly while squeezing the shoulder blades together; Return the hands slowly to straight arms without losing back position. Avoid: Leaning the torso back during the pull; Raising the shoulders toward the ears; Letting the band snap back quickly.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Banded Glute Bridge with correct form. Key points: Place a mini band above the knees and lie on your back with feet flat, hip-width apart; Press the knees slightly outward to create tension in the band; Drive through the heels and lift the hips until knees, hips and shoulders are in line; Keep the knees pressed out the whole time and lower under control. Avoid: Knees drifting inward on the way up; Over-extending with an arched lower back; Band rolling down toward the knee.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Bench Dip with correct form. Key points: Sit on the edge of a stable bench, place the palms beside the hips, and slide the glutes forward off the bench; Bend the knees with the feet flat on the floor and lift the chest with the shoulders away from the ears; Lower the body by bending the elbows back to about 90 degrees, keeping the back close to the bench; Press through the palms back to straight arms without locking the elbows. Avoid: Dropping too deep so the shoulders roll forward; Drifting away from the bench.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Bench Hip Thrust with correct form. Key points: Sit on the floor with the lower shoulder blades resting against the edge of a stable bench, knees bent; Place the feet flat, hip-width apart, so the shins are vertical at the top; Tuck the chin, brace the abs and drive through the heels to lift the hips; Pause with a straight line from knees to shoulders, then lower slowly. Avoid: Bench sliding backward during the push; Feet too far from or too close to the hips; Tilting the head back and arching the lower back.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Bodyweight Good Morning with correct form. Key points: Stand shoulder-width apart with soft knees and place the hands behind the head or crossed on the chest; Brace the abs and squeeze the shoulder blades together; Push the hips back and hinge the torso forward with a flat back until the hamstrings stretch; Drive the hips forward and stand back up while squeezing the glutes. Avoid: Rounding the back instead of hinging at the hips; Bending the knees until it becomes a squat; Locking the knees out completely.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Bodyweight Single-Leg RDL with correct form. Key points: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and hands in front or on the hips; Push the hips back while the other leg extends straight behind you, keeping the back flat; Continue until the torso is nearly parallel to the floor or you feel a hamstring stretch; Squeeze the glutes and drive the hips forward to return to standing. Avoid: Opening the hips to one side on the way down; Rounding the lower back; Bending the knee too much so it becomes a squat.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Box Squat with correct form. Key points: Stand about 30 cm in front of a knee-height box or bench with feet shoulder-width apart; Send the hips back and bend the knees under control with the chest tall; Touch the box with the glutes without relaxing or losing abdominal tension; Push the floor away through the whole foot and stand up without tilting the torso forward. Avoid: Dropping heavily onto the box; Letting the abs and back go slack on the box; Using torso momentum to stand up.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Cable Curl with correct form. Key points: Attach a straight or EZ bar to a low pulley and stand a small step back from the stack; Grip the bar underhand and pin the elbows to the ribs; Bend the elbows and pull the bar toward the chest; Lower slowly and keep tension on the cable through the whole range. Avoid: Leaning back during the pull; Letting the bar fly back at the bottom; Standing too far away so the shoulders get pulled forward.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Single-Arm Cable Lateral Raise with correct form. Key points: Set the handle at low hip height and stand sideways to the cable, gripping the handle with the hand farthest from the stack; Hold the handle across the front of the body and lean lightly on the stack with the free hand; Raise the arm out to the side in an arc to shoulder height, with the elbow leading slightly; Lower slowly across the body without losing tension in the cable, and switch arms after the set. Avoid: Leaning the torso away from the stack; Using momentum to start the rep; Raising above shoulder height.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Cable Pull-Through with correct form. Key points: Attach a rope to a low pulley, face away from the stack and hold the rope between your legs; Step forward until the cable is taut, feet shoulder-width apart with soft knees; Push the hips back until the hamstrings stretch, with a flat back and arms hanging; Squeeze the glutes and thrust the hips forward to stand tall, the rope passing between the legs. Avoid: Pulling with the arms instead of moving from the hips; Bending the knees so much it becomes a squat; Leaning back at the top.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Straight-Bar Triceps Pushdown with correct form. Key points: Attach a straight bar to the high pulley and stand close with soft knees and the torso leaning slightly forward; Take an overhand grip at shoulder width and pin the elbows to the ribs; Extend the elbows to push the bar down to straight arms, squeezing the triceps; Return under control to the lower chest without letting the elbows rise. Avoid: Leaning the whole torso over the bar to push with body weight; Cocking the wrists back at the bottom.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Cable Wood Chop with correct form. Key points: Set the cable high and stand sideways to it with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent; Hold the handle with both hands above the shoulder nearest the cable with arms almost straight; Rotate the trunk and pivot the hips as the hands travel diagonally down past the opposite knee; Pause briefly and return slowly to the start without letting the weight stack touch down; Finish the reps and switch sides. Avoid: Pulling with the arms only; Rounding the lower back at the bottom; Twisting from the lower back with the hips and feet locked in place.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Chest Dip with correct form. Key points: Grip the dip bars with straight arms and rise into a support position with the shoulders away from the ears; Lean the torso forward about 20 to 30 degrees and cross the legs behind you; Lower the body under control until the upper arms are parallel to the floor or slightly less, with the elbows flaring slightly out; Press back up to nearly straight arms while keeping the forward lean. Avoid: Dropping too deep with the shoulders rolling forward; Swinging the body for momentum; Shrugging the shoulders up to the ears.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row with correct form. Key points: Set a bench at about 30 to 45 degrees and lie chest-down on it with feet planted firmly on the floor; Hold a dumbbell in each hand with arms hanging straight under the shoulders; Pull the dumbbells toward the sides of the upper belly while squeezing the shoulder blades together; Lower under control to straight arms, letting the shoulder blades spread slightly. Avoid: Lifting the chest off the bench to help the pull; Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears; Letting the elbows flare far out without control.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Clamshell with correct form. Key points: Lie on your side with your head on your lower arm, hips bent about 45 degrees, knees bent about 90 degrees and legs stacked; Stabilize the pelvis and lightly brace the abs; Lift the top knee like opening a clamshell while the heels stay together; Pause briefly and lower slowly without rolling the pelvis backward. Avoid: Rolling the pelvis back to open higher; Lifting the foot instead of opening the knee; Moving too fast.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Close-Grip Bench Press with correct form. Key points: Lie on the bench with the eyes under the bar, feet planted, and the shoulder blades pinned to the bench; Take an overhand grip at shoulder width or slightly narrower and unrack the bar with straight arms; Lower the bar under control to the lower chest with the elbows close to the torso; Press the bar up to straight arms without lifting the glutes off the bench. Avoid: A grip so narrow that the wrists bend back; Over-arching and lifting the glutes.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Close-Grip Push-Up with correct form. Key points: Start in a high plank with the hands directly under or slightly narrower than the shoulders; Brace abs and glutes so the body forms a straight line from head to heels; Lower the chest toward the floor with the elbows travelling back and close to the ribs; Press the floor away back to straight arms without locking the elbows. Avoid: Piking the hips or letting them sag; Going so narrow that the wrists hurt.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Close Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown with correct form. Key points: Attach a close V-handle to the high cable, sit with thighs under the pad and hold the handle with a neutral grip; Lean back slightly, open the chest and draw the shoulder blades down; Pull the handle to the upper chest with the elbows travelling close to the ribs; Pause for one second and squeeze the lats; Return the handle up slowly until the arms are fully extended. Avoid: Using momentum from the lower back; Stopping short of a full stretch at the top.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Cobra Stretch with correct form. Key points: Lie face down with legs long and hands under the shoulders; Press the pelvis into the floor and push gently to lift the chest; Rise to a comfortable height with bent elbows or straight arms without lifting the pelvis; Hold for 15 to 20 seconds with calm breathing and lower back down slowly. Avoid: Pushing so hard that the pelvis lifts off the floor; Forcing the head back.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Concentration Curl with correct form. Key points: Sit on the edge of a bench with feet wide and a dumbbell in one hand; Rest the back of the upper arm against the inner thigh with the arm hanging straight; Bend the elbow and curl the dumbbell toward the shoulder without moving the upper arm; Squeeze for a second, lower slowly to full extension, then switch sides. Avoid: Leaning the body to help the lift; Letting the elbow lift off the thigh; Short lowering that never straightens the elbow.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Decline Push-Up with correct form. Key points: Place the feet on a stable surface such as a bench or chair and the hands on the floor, slightly wider than shoulders; Brace abs and glutes so the body forms a straight line from head to heels; Lower the chest toward the floor under control with elbows at about 45 degrees from the body; Press the floor away back to straight arms without lifting the hips. Avoid: Letting the lower back sag; Raising the feet so high that it becomes a shoulder-dominant vertical press; Flaring the elbows far out to the sides.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Donkey Kick with correct form. Key points: Start on all fours with hands under the shoulders and knees under the hips; Brace the abs and keep the back flat; Lift one leg with the knee bent at 90 degrees and press the heel toward the ceiling; Pause at the top, lower slowly and finish all reps before switching sides. Avoid: Arching the lower back at the top; Rotating the hips outward; Swinging fast instead of squeezing.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Dumbbell Fly with correct form. Key points: Lie on the bench with the dumbbells above the chest, palms facing and elbows slightly bent; Open the arms out to the sides in a wide controlled arc, as if hugging a barrel, until you feel a chest stretch; Keep the elbow bend fixed throughout the arc; Bring the arms back together above the chest in an arc and squeeze the chest at the end. Avoid: Straightening the elbows and overloading the joint; Dropping below bench level; Using a weight so heavy it turns into a press.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Dumbbell Front Raise with correct form. Key points: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand in front of the thighs, palms facing the body; Brace the abs and glutes and keep the elbows slightly bent; Raise the dumbbells forward in a straight line to shoulder height; Lower slowly with control back to the thighs without swinging the torso. Avoid: Rocking backward to help the weights up; Raising above shoulder height; Shrugging toward the ears.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift with correct form. Key points: Stand hip-width apart holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of the thighs, knees slightly bent; Push the hips back as if closing a door with your glutes, keeping the back flat and the weights close to the legs; Keep lowering until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings, usually around mid-shin; Drive the floor away and push the hips forward to stand tall, squeezing the glutes. Avoid: Rounding the lower back on the way down; Bending the knees too much and turning it into a squat; Letting the weights drift away from the legs.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Dumbbell Shrug with correct form. Key points: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight at the sides and palms facing in; Brace the abs lightly and keep the neck long with eyes forward; Raise the shoulders straight up toward the ears without bending the elbows; Pause at the top and lower slowly until the shoulders are fully relaxed. Avoid: Rolling the shoulders in big circles; Bending the elbows to lift the weight; Poking the chin forward.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Dumbbell Side Bend with correct form. Key points: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and one dumbbell at your side, free hand on the hip or behind the head; Brace the abs and keep the chest open with shoulders stacked over the hips; Bend slowly sideways toward the dumbbell without leaning forward or backward; Return to upright by contracting the opposite side of the trunk; Finish the reps and switch sides. Avoid: Using a dumbbell so heavy it causes swinging; Twisting forward instead of bending sideways; Holding dumbbells in both hands which cancels the opposite-side work.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Dumbbell Triceps Kickback with correct form. Key points: Stand in a slight split stance with the torso hinged forward and a flat back, supporting one hand on a bench or knee; Hold the dumbbell in the other hand and lift the elbow so the upper arm is parallel to the torso and tucked in; Extend the elbow to swing the forearm back to a straight arm without moving the upper arm; Return under control to about 90 degrees and finish the set before switching sides. Avoid: Swinging the arm and torso to move a heavy weight; Letting the elbow drop during the rep.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing EZ-Bar Curl with correct form. Key points: Stand tall and hold the EZ bar on the outer angled sections with palms facing forward and up; Brace the abs and pin the elbows to the ribs; Bend the elbows and curl the bar to upper chest height; Lower the bar slowly to almost straight arms. Avoid: Rocking the body and arching the back; Letting the elbows rise forward during the curl; Using a load so heavy that range of motion is cut short.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing EZ-Bar Skull Crusher with correct form. Key points: Lie on a bench and hold an EZ-bar with an inner grip at shoulder width, arms straight above the chest; Tilt the upper arms slightly back, about 10 to 15 degrees from vertical, to keep tension on the triceps; Bend the elbows to lower the bar under control toward the forehead or just behind the head without flaring; Extend the elbows to return the bar up without moving the upper arms. Avoid: Letting the elbows flare; Turning the rep into a shoulder press.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Flutter Kick with correct form. Key points: Lie on the back with hands under the pelvis or at the sides and legs straight; Press the lower back into the floor and raise the legs about 15 to 30 cm off the floor; Kick the legs up and down in short, quick, alternating motions as in swimming; Keep the abs braced and breathe at a steady rhythm until time is up. Avoid: Arching the lower back when the legs are too low; Kicking too wide, which shifts the work to the hips; Holding the breath during the set.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Forward Lunge with correct form. Key points: Stand tall hips-width apart with hands on the hips; Take a big step forward and land on the heel under control, without slapping; Lower the back knee toward the floor until the front thigh is nearly parallel and the front shin nearly vertical; Push hard through the front foot back to standing and switch legs. Avoid: Short step that pushes the front knee far past the toes; Rushing back up using momentum instead of strength; Front knee collapsing inward.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Barbell Front Squat with correct form. Key points: Set the bar in the rack at shoulder height and rest it on the front shoulders beside the neck with elbows high; Step back out of the rack and stand shoulder-width apart with toes turned out slightly; Lower under control with elbows staying high and chest tall, to at least parallel; Drive through the whole foot and stand up with the elbows high to full standing. Avoid: Elbows dropping so the bar rolls forward; Rounding the upper chest; Heels lifting.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch with correct form. Key points: Kneel on one knee on a mat or cushion with the other foot in front at about 90 degrees; Squeeze the glute on the kneeling side and tilt the pelvis slightly backward; Shift forward gently until a stretch is felt at the front of the kneeling hip; Hold for 30 seconds with slow breathing and switch sides. Avoid: Arching the lower back instead of tilting the pelvis; Leaning forward without squeezing the glute.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Half-Kneeling Landmine Press with correct form. Key points: Anchor the end of the bar in a corner or landmine unit and kneel on one knee, with the knee nearest the anchor on the floor; Hold the end of the bar with one hand at shoulder height, with the hips and chest stable; Press the bar forward and up in an arc until the arm is almost fully extended; Lower with control back to the shoulder and finish all reps before switching sides. Avoid: Leaning the torso sideways; Arching the lower back; A sharp drop without control.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Hanging Knee Raise with correct form. Key points: Hang from a pull-up bar with a grip slightly wider than the shoulders and pull the shoulder blades down; Keep the body still and stop any swinging before starting the rep; Exhale and raise the knees toward the chest while curling the pelvis forward; Pause briefly at the top and lower slowly to a full hang without swinging. Avoid: Swinging the body to build momentum; Lifting the knees without curling the pelvis, so the hip flexors do all the work; Letting the shoulders shrug up to the ears in a passive hang.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Heel Touches with correct form. Key points: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat hip-width apart and arms by your sides; Lift the shoulder blades about 2 to 3 cm off the floor, without tucking the chin or pulling on the neck; Bend the trunk sideways and reach one hand toward the heel on that side; Switch to the other side with a small controlled motion and keep alternating. Avoid: Yanking the neck with the head; Sitting up instead of bending sideways.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing High Knees with correct form. Key points: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms bent at chest height; Drive one knee up to hip height while the opposite arm swings forward; Switch legs quickly in a running-in-place rhythm, landing on the ball of the foot; Keep the chest tall and abs braced until the time is up. Avoid: Leaning the torso backward; Landing heavily on the heels.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing High-to-Low Cable Crossover with correct form. Key points: Set the cables at the high position, grab the handles and step forward into a split stance; Lean the torso slightly forward and start with arms open and raised, elbows slightly bent; Pull the handles in a downward and inward arc until they meet in front of the lower abs; Squeeze the chest briefly and return slowly to the start with a comfortable stretch. Avoid: Pulling with the back and shoulders instead of the chest; Standing upright with no slight forward lean; Using a heavy weight and momentum.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Hip Abduction Machine with correct form. Key points: Sit in the machine with your back flat against the pad and the cushions on the outside of the knees; Set a comfortable starting range so the legs are close together but not overlapping; Push the legs apart with force while the glutes and back stay in contact with the seat; Pause briefly at the wide point and return slowly without letting the plates crash. Avoid: Leaning the torso forward and using momentum; Starting range too wide; Heavy weight that prevents controlled return.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Hollow Body Hold with correct form. Key points: Lie on the back with legs straight and arms extended beside the ears; Press the lower back firmly into the floor and brace the abs; Lift the shoulders and legs off the floor so the body forms a shallow banana shape; Hold the position with short, quiet breaths, then lower slowly at the end. Avoid: Arching the lower back when the legs are too low; Jamming the chin into the chest and straining the neck; Holding the breath during the hold.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Inchworm with correct form. Key points: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart; Hinge at the hips and place the hands on the floor in front of the feet, bending the knees slightly if needed; Walk the hands forward into a high plank with the abs and glutes braced; Walk the feet in small steps toward the hands, lift the hips and stand up. Avoid: Letting the hips sag in the plank position; Rushing through and skipping the hamstring stretch.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Incline Barbell Bench Press with correct form. Key points: Set the bench to 30 to 45 degrees and lie back with shoulder blades pinched and feet planted; Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders and unrack it with straight arms; Lower the bar under control to the upper chest, at or just below collarbone height; Press the bar up until the arms are straight over the shoulders; Rack the bar at the end of the set. Avoid: An angle so steep it turns into a shoulder press; Lifting the glutes off the bench; Lowering the bar toward the neck.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Jump Rope with correct form. Key points: Pick a rope that reaches the armpits when standing on its middle; Hold the handles with elbows close to the ribs and turn the rope using the wrists; Jump low on the balls of the feet, only a few centimeters off the floor; Keep a steady rhythm of one jump per rope turn. Avoid: Jumping too high; Turning the rope from the shoulders; Landing on the heels.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Jump Squat with correct form. Key points: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes turned slightly out; Drop into a quarter to half squat with the chest up and hands clasped in front; Drive the floor away fast and jump straight up, fully extending the hips and knees; Land softly on the whole foot with bent knees and flow into the next repetition. Avoid: Knees collapsing inward on landing; Squatting too deep, which slows the jump.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Kettlebell Overhead Press with correct form. Key points: Clean the kettlebell to the rack position at the chest with the elbow tucked to the ribs and the bell resting on the forearm; Stand hip-width with glutes and abs tight and the free hand relaxed at the side; Press the kettlebell straight up until the arm is extended, keeping the bell close to the forearm; Lower with control back to the rack and finish all reps before switching arms. Avoid: Leaning sideways to finish the press; Bending the wrist back so the bell crashes onto the forearm; Flaring the ribs forward with an arched back.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Knee Push-Up with correct form. Key points: Place the knees on a mat and the hands slightly wider than shoulders; Brace abs and glutes so the body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees; Lower the chest toward the floor with elbows at about 45 degrees from the body; Press the floor away back to straight arms without locking the elbows. Avoid: Breaking at the hips and lifting the glutes toward the ceiling; Short range of motion without getting close to the floor.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Lateral Lunge with correct form. Key points: Stand tall with feet together and hands in front of the chest; Take a wide step to the side with the toes pointing forward and push the hips back; Bend the stepping knee to near parallel while the other leg stays straight with the foot flat; Push hard through the bent leg back to standing and repeat to the other side. Avoid: Stepping sideways without sitting the hips back; Rounding the lower back; Lifting the heel of the stepping foot.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Machine Leg Extension with correct form. Key points: Adjust the backrest so the knees line up with the machine pivot and place the ankles under the lower pad; Grip the handles, press the back against the pad and select a moderate weight; Extend the knees to almost full extension and squeeze the front of the thighs at the top; Lower under control for about 2 seconds back to knees bent at about 90 degrees. Avoid: Using swing instead of control; Lifting the hips off the seat; Snapping the knees locked at the top.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Lying Leg Raise with correct form. Key points: Lie on the back with arms at the sides or under the pelvis and legs straight and together; Press the lower back into the floor and brace the lower abs; Raise the straight legs until they are at 90 degrees to the floor; Lower slowly until the feet almost touch the floor while the lower back stays pressed down. Avoid: Letting the lower back peel off the floor on the way down; Bouncing at the bottom to kick the legs up; Lowering the legs past the point where the back can stay flat.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Neutral-Grip Pull-Up with correct form. Key points: Grip the parallel handles of the bar with a neutral grip, palms facing each other; Hang with straight arms, draw the shoulder blades down and keep the legs together; Pull the elbows down toward the ribs until the chin clears the handles; Lower the body slowly to straight arms. Avoid: Using hip momentum to pull; Partial reps that never reach straight arms.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Oblique Crunch with correct form. Key points: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet on the floor, one hand behind the head and the other by your side; Lift the shoulder and shoulder blade toward the opposite knee while rotating the ribcage slightly; Pause for a second at the top and feel the squeeze on the side of the abs; Lower slowly and finish all reps on one side before switching. Avoid: Pulling the head with the hands; Using momentum instead of a squeeze; Sitting all the way up with no rotation.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Overhead Cable Triceps Extension with correct form. Key points: Attach a rope to a low or mid pulley and stand facing away from the stack in a split stance; Hold the rope ends and raise them overhead with the elbows pointing forward and close to the ears; Bend the elbows to lower the hands behind the head without moving the upper arms; Extend the elbows to press forward and up to straight arms, squeezing the triceps. Avoid: Letting the elbows flare out; Arching the lower back during the extension.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension with correct form. Key points: Sit or stand tall and hold one dumbbell with both hands, palms cupping the underside of the top plate; Raise the dumbbell overhead to straight arms with the ribs down and the abs braced; Bend the elbows to lower the dumbbell behind the head, elbows pointing to the ceiling and close to the ears; Extend the elbows to return overhead without moving the upper arms. Avoid: Letting the elbows flare to the sides; Arching the lower back to lift the dumbbell.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Pec Deck Fly with correct form. Key points: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height and sit with the back against the pad; Grip the handles or rest the forearms on the pads with the elbows slightly below shoulder height; Bring the arms together in front of the chest until the handles meet and squeeze the chest; Return slowly to the open position with a comfortable stretch without letting the stack drop. Avoid: Arching the back and shrugging the shoulders to the ears; Opening too far behind the body line; Using momentum.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Plank with Leg Lift with correct form. Key points: Start in a forearm or high plank with the body in one straight line; Brace the abs and glutes and lift one straight leg to hip height; Hold for two to three seconds without rotating the pelvis or arching the lower back; Lower the leg to the floor and switch. Avoid: Lifting the leg too high with an arched back; Rotating the pelvis to one side; Letting the hips drop while the leg is up.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Plank Shoulder Taps with correct form. Key points: Start in a high plank with hands under the shoulders and feet hip-width or slightly wider; Brace the abs and glutes so the body forms a straight line from head to heels; Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder without letting the hips rock side to side; Return the hand to the floor and alternate at a slow, controlled pace. Avoid: Rocking the hips from side to side; Piking the hips up; Going too fast and losing control.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Prone Lat Pull-Down with correct form. Key points: Lie face down on the floor with the forehead on a folded towel and arms straight overhead; Lift the hands slightly off the floor and draw the shoulder blades down toward the hips; Pull the elbows back and out to rib height, like pulling a bar on a lat pulldown; Pause for one second at the end and feel the lats squeeze; Slowly return the arms forward without resting them on the floor. Avoid: Lifting the chest and head too high, which loads the lower back; Shrugging toward the ears instead of depressing the shoulder blades.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Prone Y Raise with correct form. Key points: Lie face down on a mat with the forehead near the floor and the arms straight out in a Y shape; Turn the thumbs up and draw the shoulder blades down and back; Lift the arms a few centimeters off the floor without lifting the head or chest; Hold one second at the top and lower slowly until the hands barely touch the floor. Avoid: Craning the head and neck up; Arching the lower back to lift higher; Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Reverse Crunch with correct form. Key points: Lie on the back with arms at the sides and palms on the floor; Lift the legs so the knees are bent at about 90 degrees over the hips; Exhale and curl the pelvis up so the knees travel toward the chest and the lower back lifts slightly; Pause briefly and lower slowly until the lower back touches the floor, without resting the heels. Avoid: Swinging the legs instead of contracting the abs; Resting the heels on the floor between reps; Over-arching the lower back on the way down.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Reverse Pec Deck with correct form. Key points: Sit facing the machine with the chest against the pad and the handles at shoulder height; Grip the handles with elbows slightly bent and shoulders relaxed; Open the arms out to the sides and back in an arc, squeezing the shoulder blades; Return slowly to the start without resting the weight stack. Avoid: Yanking with the lower back; Shrugging toward the ears; Heavy weight that cuts the range short.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Rowing Machine with correct form. Key points: Sit on the machine, strap the feet in and hold the handle with straight arms; Start with the legs: push the feet away while the torso stays upright; When the legs are almost straight, lean back slightly and pull the handle to the lower ribs; Return in reverse order: arms first, then lean the torso forward and only then bend the knees. Avoid: Bending the knees before the arms have extended on the recovery; Rounding the back at the front of the stroke; Pulling with the shoulders shrugged toward the ears.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Scapular Pull-Up with correct form. Key points: Hang from the bar overhand at shoulder width with straight arms and relaxed shoulders; Without bending the elbows, pull the shoulder blades down to lift the body a few centimeters; Pause for one second at the top and feel the lats and mid back working; Slowly return to a full hang. Avoid: Bending the elbows and turning it into a partial pull-up; Swinging the body to create momentum.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Seated Calf Raise Machine with correct form. Key points: Sit in the machine with the knee pads locked over the thighs and the balls of the feet on the platform; Lower the heels to a comfortable stretch; Rise as high as possible onto the toes and pause for a second; Lower slowly to a light stretch at the bottom and repeat. Avoid: Short bounces with no full range; Too much weight with momentum; Feet turning outward or inward.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Side-Lying Leg Raise with correct form. Key points: Lie on your side with the body in a straight line from head to heels and head resting on the lower arm; Bend the bottom leg slightly for stability and place the top hand on the floor in front of the chest; Raise the top leg straight up with the toes pointing forward; Pause briefly and lower slowly without moving the pelvis. Avoid: Lifting too high while leaning the torso; Rotating the foot up so the hip flexor takes over; Using momentum.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Side Plank Hip Dip with correct form. Key points: Start in a forearm side plank with the body in one line; Lower the hips slowly toward the floor without touching it; Drive the hips back up to full height by squeezing the side of the trunk; Complete the target reps, then switch sides. Avoid: Dropping fast to the floor without control; Rotating the shoulders and chest forward.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Bent-Knee Side Plank with correct form. Key points: Lie on one side with the elbow under the shoulder, hips straight and knees bent to about 90 degrees; Keep the bottom knee and forearm on the mat as the support points; Lift the hips until the shoulder, hip and knee are in one line; Brace the abs, hold while breathing, then lower and switch sides. Avoid: Rolling the hips backward instead of lifting them up; Shrugging the shoulder up to the ear.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Single-Leg Glute Bridge with correct form. Key points: Lie on your back with one foot flat and bent, the other leg extended in the air; Level the pelvis so both hips are at the same height and brace the abs; Drive through the heel and lift the hips until knee, hip and shoulder are in line; Lower slowly without rotating, and finish all reps before switching legs. Avoid: Letting the pelvis drop toward the free leg; Arching the lower back to get height; Using momentum instead of control.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Sit-Up with correct form. Key points: Lie on the back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor; Cross the arms on the chest or rest the fingertips lightly beside the temples; Exhale and roll the spine up one vertebra at a time until sitting tall; Reach slightly forward at the top so the chest approaches the thighs; Lower slowly, one vertebra at a time, back to lying flat. Avoid: Jerking up with momentum while pulling on the neck; Dropping back to the floor without control; Rounding up without bracing, so the hip flexors do all the work.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Stationary Bike with correct form.
