Key points: Set the saddle height so the knee is almost straight when the pedal is at its lowest point; Sit tall, hold the handlebars lightly and place the feet on the pedals; Pedal at a steady cadence and comfortable resistance with the knees tracking in line over the feet; Keep breathing continuous and raise resistance or cadence gradually as needed. Avoid: A saddle that is too low, which loads the knees; Leaning heavily on the handlebars; High resistance at too slow a cadence.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Box Step-Up with correct form. Key points: Stand facing a stable box at a height that puts the knee at about 90 degrees with the foot on it; Place the whole first foot on the box with the torso tall and eyes forward; Drive through the heel of the top foot to full standing, without pushing off the bottom foot; Lower the other foot back to the floor under control, and finish the set before switching legs. Avoid: Pushing off the bottom leg instead of the top leg; Leaning the torso forward; Top knee collapsing inward.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Dumbbell Sumo Squat with correct form. Key points: Stand in a wide stance, wider than shoulder width, with toes turned out about 45 degrees; Hold one dumbbell vertically with both hands hanging between the legs and arms straight; Lower under control as the knees open in the direction of the toes and the torso stays tall; Drive through the whole foot back to standing, squeezing the glutes and inner thighs. Avoid: Knees collapsing inward; Torso leaning forward; Heels lifting.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Superman with correct form. Key points: Lie face down on a mat with arms straight overhead and legs straight hip-width apart; Look at the floor to keep the neck in line with the spine; Raise arms, chest and legs off the floor at the same time without cranking the neck; Hold for one or two seconds at the top and lower slowly back to the floor. Avoid: Lifting the head high and tipping the neck back; Sharply arching the lower back; Fast bouncing movements.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Supine Hamstring Stretch with correct form. Key points: Lie on the back with both legs straight on the floor; Lift one leg and hold behind the thigh, or loop a towel or strap around the foot; Straighten the knee as far as is comfortable and draw the leg gently toward the body until a stretch is felt behind the thigh; Hold for 30 seconds with calm breathing, then switch legs. Avoid: Pulling so hard that the pelvis lifts off the floor; Bouncing in and out of the stretch.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Tempo Pause Squat with correct form. Key points: Stand shoulder-width apart with hands clasped in front of the chest; Lower under control for about 3 seconds to full depth or your comfortable depth; Pause at the bottom for about 2 seconds without losing tension or relaxing; Rise at a moderate speed to full standing and repeat. Avoid: Dropping into the bottom instead of lowering under control; Bouncing out of the bottom without a real pause; Letting the back go slack during the pause.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Thoracic Open-Book Rotation with correct form. Key points: Lie on one side with knees bent to 90 degrees and stacked, arms reaching forward with palms together; Keep the knees together and lift the top hand, opening it in an arc toward the other side; Follow the hand with the eyes and rotate the rib cage until the shoulder approaches the floor; Breathe deeply, return slowly to the start and finish the repetitions before switching sides. Avoid: Letting the knees open or the pelvis roll instead of rotating the rib cage; Forcing the range until the shoulder or neck hurts.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing TRX Row with correct form. Key points: Hold the TRX handles, step forward and lean back until the arms are straight and the body is in one line; Brace the abs and glutes and keep the feet planted on the floor; Pull the chest toward the handles while squeezing the shoulder blades and keeping the elbows close to the body; Lower the body slowly to straight arms and repeat. Avoid: Twisting the torso or sagging the hips; Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears; Using leg momentum.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Dumbbell Upright Row with correct form. Key points: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of the thighs, palms facing the body and hands about hip-width apart; Brace the abs and keep the shoulders away from the ears; Pull the dumbbells up along the body to chest height, elbows leading and staying above the wrists; Lower slowly with control to straight arms without rocking the torso. Avoid: Pulling very high to the chin with shrugged shoulders; A very narrow grip that jams the shoulder; Rocking the torso to lift a heavy weight.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing V-Up with correct form. Key points: Lie on the back with straight legs and arms extended overhead; Brace the abs and lift the arms and straight legs at the same time so the body forms a V; Reach the hands toward the feet at the top while balancing on the tailbone; Lower the arms and legs slowly without resting them on the floor, then repeat. Avoid: Arching the lower back on the way down when the legs go too low; Swinging the arms instead of contracting the abs; Bending the knees uncontrollably to shorten the movement.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Walking Lunge with correct form. Key points: Stand tall with hands on the hips and about 10 meters of clear space ahead; Take a long step forward and lower the back knee close to the floor; Push through the front leg and bring the back leg forward directly into the next lunge; Keep alternating at a steady pace with the torso tall and eyes forward. Avoid: Short steps that overload the knees; Tipping the torso forward with a slack core; Going so fast that control and balance suffer.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Wall Angel with correct form. Key points: Stand with back, buttocks and head against a wall and feet about 15 centimeters from the wall; Press the elbows and arms against the wall in a W at shoulder height; Slowly slide the arms up the wall to a Y without lifting the ribs or peeling the back off; Slide back down to the W and repeat with control. Avoid: Arching the lower back away from the wall; Raising the shoulders toward the ears; Letting elbows or hands peel off the wall.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Wall Push-Up with correct form. Key points: Stand one step from the wall and place the hands on it at shoulder height, slightly wider than shoulders; Brace abs and glutes and keep the body straight from head to heels; Bend the elbows and bring the chest toward the wall; Push the wall away back to straight arms. Avoid: Hips sagging toward the wall; Flaring the elbows far out to the sides; Lifting the heels off the floor.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Wall Sit with correct form. Key points: Press the back and hips against a wall and walk the feet out about 60 cm in small steps; Slide down until the thighs are nearly parallel to the floor with knees over the ankles; Keep the whole back against the wall with hands at the sides or on the thighs, not on the knees; Hold the position for the target time while breathing normally. Avoid: Feet too close to the wall so the knees travel past the toes; Pushing the hands onto the knees; Holding the breath during the hold.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Wall Slide with correct form. Key points: Stand with back, glutes and head against the wall and feet about 15 cm away from it; Raise the arms out to the sides with elbows bent 90 degrees so the backs of the hands and elbows touch the wall; Slide the arms slowly up the wall without losing contact, to a comfortable height; Slide back down with control until the elbows return to shoulder height. Avoid: Arching the lower back to reach higher; Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears; Letting the elbows or hands peel off the wall.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Dumbbell Wrist Curl with correct form. Key points: Sit on a bench and rest the forearm on the thigh or bench with the hand past the edge, palm facing up; Hold a light dumbbell and let it roll down to the fingertips; Close the fingers and curl the wrist to lift the dumbbell as high as possible; Lower slowly through a comfortable range and repeat. Avoid: Lifting the forearm off its support; Using a weight so heavy that range shrinks; Swinging from the elbow.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Ab Wheel Rollout with correct form. Key points: Kneel on a mat and hold the wheel handles under the shoulders with a neutral back; Tuck the pelvis slightly and brace the abs and glutes; Roll forward slowly with straight arms as far as the lower back can stay braced; Pull the wheel back by contracting the abs and lats, without pushing the hips back first. Avoid: Letting the lower back sag as the wheel moves away; Pushing the hips back instead of pulling with the abs; Rolling out too far before control is built.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Arm Circles with correct form. Key points: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height; Make small circles forward for about 10 to 15 reps without shrugging; Gradually enlarge the circles to a comfortable, controlled range; Switch direction and repeat the same number of reps backward. Avoid: Swinging the arms quickly with momentum; Shrugging toward the ears on every circle.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Assisted Pistol Squat with correct form. Key points: Stand on one leg next to a door frame, post or sturdy pole and hold it with one hand at chest height; Extend the free leg forward and keep the torso upright; Lower slowly on the standing leg, keeping the heel down, to your comfortable depth; Push back up with the standing leg and use the hand only as much as needed, then switch legs. Avoid: Pulling hard with the hand instead of using the leg; Heel lifting at depth; Knee caving inward.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Machine Back Extension with correct form. Key points: Adjust the machine so the pad sits just below the hip crease, the feet are secure and the torso can hinge freely from the hips; Brace the abs and start with the torso lowered and back flat, with light load on the chest or in the machine; Extend the torso slowly to a straight line from head to heels while squeezing the glutes; Lower slowly back to the start without rounding the back. Avoid: Over-arching the back at the top; Fast swinging up and down; A pad set wrongly so the bend comes from the back instead of the hips.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Resistance Band Chest Fly with correct form. Key points: Anchor the band behind you at chest height, grip the ends and step forward until there is light tension; Stand in a split stance with elbows slightly bent and arms open to the sides; Sweep the arms forward in an arc until the hands meet in front of the chest; Squeeze the chest briefly and return slowly to the open position without losing band tension. Avoid: An unstable anchor that slips mid-set; Bending the elbows so it turns into a press; Leaning the torso backward.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Band Shoulder Pass-Through with correct form. Key points: Hold a light band with a grip wider than the shoulders and straight arms in front of the thighs; Brace the abs and glutes and raise the band forward and up with straight arms; Carry it over the head toward the back until a stretch is felt through the shoulders and chest; Pause briefly, then return along the same path slowly to the start. Avoid: Using a grip so narrow that the elbows bend; Arching the lower back to finish the range; Choosing a band that is too stiff.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Band Triceps Kickback with correct form. Key points: Stand on one end of the band with the front foot in a split stance, torso hinged forward with a flat back; Hold the other end, pin the upper arm to the torso, and bend the elbow; Extend the elbow to stretch the band back to a straight arm without moving the upper arm; Return under control to about 90 degrees and finish the set before switching sides. Avoid: Pulling from the shoulder instead of the elbow; Letting the band snap back without control.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Banded Lateral Walk with correct form. Key points: Place a mini band above the knees or ankles and stand shoulder-width apart; Soften the knees and hips into a quarter squat and keep the chest up; Step sideways with the leading foot while keeping tension on the band; Bring the trailing foot in without letting the knees cave, and take 8 to 10 steps each direction. Avoid: Knees collapsing inward; Snapping the trailing foot in and losing tension; Leaning the torso side to side.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Barbell Push Press with correct form. Key points: Unrack the bar to the front rack on the front delts with elbows slightly forward and feet hip-width; Brace the abs and make a short, quick knee dip of about 10 cm with an upright torso; Extend the legs explosively and drive the bar up, continuing to press with the arms; Lock the elbows overhead and lower the bar to the shoulders absorbing slightly through the knees. Avoid: A dip so deep it becomes a squat; Leaning back during the drive; Pausing between the dip and the drive which wastes the leg momentum.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Bear Crawl with correct form. Key points: Start on all fours with the knees hovering 2 to 3 cm above the floor; Move one hand and the opposite foot forward together in a short step; Switch to the other side and keep a steady rhythm with a flat back and low hips; Crawl for a set distance or time and stop under control. Avoid: Lifting the hips too high; Taking wide steps that twist the pelvis.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Bear Crawl Hold with correct form. Key points: Start on all fours with hands under the shoulders and knees under the hips; Curl the toes under and lift the knees about 2 to 3 cm off the floor; Keep the back flat, hips low and the gaze slightly forward; Brace the abs and quads, breathe steadily and hold for the target time. Avoid: Hiking the hips up like a downward dog; Lifting the knees too high which takes load off the abs.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Cable Glute Kickback with correct form. Key points: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and secure it around one ankle; Face the machine, hold the frame and lean slightly forward with a flat back; Kick the leg back and slightly up, squeezing the glute without moving the pelvis; Pause briefly and return the leg slowly without letting the cable go slack. Avoid: Arching the lower back to lift the leg higher; Rotating the pelvis to the side; Swinging instead of controlling.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Single-Arm Cable Rear Delt Fly with correct form. Key points: Set the handle at shoulder height and stand sideways to the stack, with the far hand gripping the handle and doing the work; Keep the elbow slightly bent and the torso steady, with the other hand holding the stack; Pull the arm back and out to the side in an arc at shoulder height until the shoulder blade squeezes; Return slowly to the start and switch arms after the set. Avoid: Twisting the torso to finish the rep; Pulling with the shoulder instead of the shoulder blade; A heavy weight that ruins the range.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Cossack Squat with correct form. Key points: Stand in a wide stance, roughly twice shoulder width, with toes turned out slightly; Sit the hips back and shift to one side until that knee bends deeply while the other leg stays straight; Keep the heel of the bent leg on the floor, with the straight leg toes pointing up if the ankle allows; Push back through the bent leg, pass through the center and shift to the other side. Avoid: Heel lifting during the descent; Rounding the back to reach depth; Knee collapsing inward.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Dumbbell Cuban Press with correct form. Key points: Stand tall with very light dumbbells hanging in front of the thighs; Pull the elbows out to the sides up to shoulder height like a low upright row, keeping the dumbbells below the elbows; Rotate the forearms upward until they are vertical, so the dumbbells are by the ears; Press the dumbbells overhead to full extension, then reverse the whole sequence under control. Avoid: Heavy weight that turns it into a swing; Letting the elbows drop during the rotation; Shrugging toward the ears.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Curtsy Lunge with correct form. Key points: Stand tall hips-width apart with hands clasped in front of the chest; Step one leg back on a diagonal behind the front leg, as in a curtsy; Lower the back knee toward the floor while the front knee stays tracking over the foot; Drive through the front leg back to standing, and finish the set before switching sides. Avoid: Front knee collapsing inward; Twisting the hips and torso to the side; Diagonal step that is too short.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat with correct form. Key points: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides and rest the top of the back foot on a bench; Stand at a distance where the front knee stays over the ankle at the bottom, with the torso tall and shoulders back; Lower the back knee under control until the front thigh is nearly parallel to the floor; Drive through the whole front foot back up, and finish the set before switching legs. Avoid: Dumbbells so heavy the technique breaks down; Leaning the torso forward; Wobbling and shifting weight between the legs.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Dumbbell Floor Press with correct form. Key points: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand above the chest; Lower the dumbbells under control until the upper arms lightly touch the floor; Pause briefly without resting the arm weight on the floor; Press back up to straight arms above the shoulders. Avoid: Over-arching the lower back off the floor; Dropping the elbows onto the floor; Lowering fast without control.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Static Dumbbell Hold with correct form. Key points: Pick up a relatively heavy dumbbell in each hand with bent knees and a flat back, then stand tall with the arms at the sides; Grip hard at the center of the handle with straight wrists and shoulders down and back; Hold the dumbbells without moving the body for 20 to 40 seconds; Set the dumbbells down carefully on the floor or on a rack. Avoid: Letting the wrists sag; Rounding the shoulders forward; Holding the breath for the entire hold.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Feet-Elevated Pike Push-Up with correct form. Key points: Place the feet on a stable bench and start in a pike with hands shoulder-width apart; Walk the hands closer to the bench so the torso is almost vertical and the hips are over the shoulders; Bend the elbows and lower the head toward the floor between the hands, elbows about 45 degrees from the body; Drive the floor away hard and return to straight arms without dropping the hips. Avoid: Flaring the elbows on the way down; Arching the back to push; Dropping onto the head with no depth limit.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Feet-Elevated Glute Bridge with correct form. Key points: Lie on your back with heels on a stable surface about 30 to 45 cm high, such as a couch or sturdy chair; Bend the knees to about 90 degrees and rest the arms at your sides; Brace the abs and glutes and drive through the heels to lift the hips; Pause at the top, then lower slowly until the hips lightly touch the floor. Avoid: Using an unstable surface that slides during the push; Going too high with an arched lower back; Letting the heels lift off the surface.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Fire Hydrant with correct form. Key points: Start on all fours with hands under the shoulders and knees under the hips; Brace the abs and keep the back flat; Lift one leg out to the side with the knee still bent, up to roughly hip height; Pause briefly and lower slowly without rotating the torso. Avoid: Leaning the torso to the opposite side; Lifting too high while rotating the pelvis; Dropping the leg quickly with no control.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Dumbbell Floor Triceps Press with correct form. Key points: Lie on your back on the floor with the knees bent, holding two dumbbells with the palms facing each other; Press the dumbbells above the chest to straight arms and keep them close together; Lower the dumbbells under control until the upper arms touch the floor, with the elbows close to the torso; Press the dumbbells back up to straight arms, squeezing the triceps. Avoid: Flaring the elbows out to the sides; Dropping the arms to the floor without control.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Machine Hack Squat with correct form. Key points: Press the back and shoulders into the machine pad and place the feet shoulder-width apart slightly forward on the platform; Release the safety catches and lower the body under control with knees tracking the toes; Descend until the thighs are parallel to the platform or lower, without the hips peeling off the pad; Press through the whole foot to almost full extension and repeat. Avoid: Bouncing out of the bottom, overloading the knees; Heels lifting off the platform; Forcing the knees to lock at the top.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Hanging Leg Raise with correct form. Key points: Hang from a pull-up bar with a grip slightly wider than the shoulders and pull the shoulder blades down; Brace the abs and glutes and lock the legs straight and together; Raise the straight legs toward the bar while curling the pelvis, at least to hip height; Pause briefly and lower slowly to a full hang with no swing and no kip. Avoid: Swinging the body and kipping; Dropping fast on the way down, which loads the lower back and shoulders; Bending the knees mid-set as fatigue builds instead of ending the set.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Incline Dumbbell Curl with correct form. Key points: Set a bench to about 45 to 60 degrees and sit with the back against the pad; Let the arms hang straight down holding dumbbells with palms facing forward; Bend the elbows and curl the dumbbells without moving the upper arms forward; Lower slowly to full extension to stretch the biceps at the bottom. Avoid: Rolling the shoulders forward off the bench to make it easier; Skipping the full stretch at the bottom; Choosing a weight so heavy that form breaks down.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Kettlebell Goblet Squat with correct form. Key points: Hold the kettlebell by the horns with both hands, bell down and tight to the chest; Stand shoulder-width apart or slightly wider with toes turned out slightly; Lower under control as the elbows travel between the knees and the chest stays tall; Drive through the whole foot back to standing without letting the kettlebell leave the chest. Avoid: Torso pitching forward; Loose grip that lets the weight slip; Knees caving inward.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Knee Diamond Push-Up with correct form. Key points: Set up on all fours with the knees on the floor and the body in a straight line from knees to head; Bring thumbs and index fingers together under the chest to form a diamond shape; Brace the abs and lower the chest toward the hands with the elbows travelling back and close to the ribs; Press the floor away back to straight arms without locking the elbows. Avoid: Letting the hips sag toward the floor; Flaring the elbows out wide.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Landmine T-Bar Row with correct form. Key points: Stand over the end of a barbell anchored in a landmine, feet shoulder-width, and grip the handle under the bar; Hinge forward with a flat back and bent knees, the bar hanging between your legs; Pull the bar to the lower chest while squeezing the shoulder blades; Lower the weight under control to straight arms without standing up or rounding the back. Avoid: Standing up to lift the weight; Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears; Locking the knees and rounding the back.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Leaning Dumbbell Lateral Raise with correct form. Key points: Hold an upright post or rack with one hand and lean away at about 15 to 20 degrees; Hold a light dumbbell in the other hand with the arm hanging straight down and the elbow slightly bent; Raise the dumbbell out to the side to shoulder height without changing the lean angle; Lower slowly until the arm hangs again and switch sides after the set. Avoid: Increasing the lean during the rep to gain momentum; A weight too heavy that hikes the shoulder; Lifting the shoulder instead of the arm.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Long-Lever Plank with correct form. Key points: Start in a forearm plank, then slide the elbows forward about 10 to 20 cm ahead of the shoulder line; Lift the body onto the toes and straighten the legs; Tuck the pelvis slightly and squeeze the abs and glutes hard so the long lever does not arch the back; Hold for a shorter time than a regular plank, with short, quiet breaths. Avoid: Arching the lower back when the lever is too long; Piking the hips up to escape the load; Holding too long while form breaks down.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Low-to-High Cable Crossover with correct form. Key points: Set the cables at the low position, grab the handles and step forward into a split stance; Lean the torso slightly forward and start with arms open and lowered, elbows slightly bent; Pull the handles in an upward and inward arc until they meet in front of the upper chest; Squeeze the upper chest briefly and return slowly to the start. Avoid: Shrugging the shoulders at the top; Using momentum from the knees and back; Pulling above eye level.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Medicine Ball Slam with correct form. Key points: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a dead-bounce medicine ball with both hands at chest height; Raise the ball overhead, rising onto the toes and opening the chest; Brace the abs and slam the ball into the floor with force as the hips push back and the torso folds forward; Pick the ball up under control with a short squat and return to standing for the next rep. Avoid: Slamming with the arms only, without the abs and legs; Using a bouncy ball that can rebound into the face.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Negative Pull-Up with correct form. Key points: Stand on a bench or box under the bar and grip it overhand at shoulder width; Jump or step up to the top position with the chin above the bar and chest close to it; Lower the body slowly over 3 to 5 seconds until the arms are straight; Step back onto the box, breathe and repeat. Avoid: Dropping quickly and uncontrolled through the bottom half; Doing too many reps, which causes severe soreness.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Neutral-Grip Dumbbell Press with correct form. Key points: Lie on the bench with the dumbbells in a neutral grip, palms facing each other; Pinch the shoulder blades and press the dumbbells over the chest with straight arms; Lower the dumbbells under control to the sides of the chest with the elbows close to the body; Press back up without locking the elbows. Avoid: Rotating the palms mid-rep; Dropping fast without control; Lifting the head off the bench.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing 90/90 Hip Switch with correct form. Key points: Sit on the floor with both knees bent to 90 degrees, one leg in front and one to the side, torso upright; Lean slightly forward over the front leg with a long spine until a stretch is felt in the glute; Lift both knees slightly and rotate them to the other side without using the hands; Set the legs down in the mirrored position and repeat the movement at a slow pace. Avoid: Propping on the hands throughout the movement; Rounding the back to reach toward the front leg.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Pendlay Row with correct form. Key points: Set the bar on the floor over mid-foot and stand hip-width apart; Hinge until the torso is almost parallel to the floor, grip slightly wider than shoulders and brace abs and shoulder blades; Pull the bar fast from the floor to the lower chest without moving the torso; Lower the bar under control back to the floor, pause and start each rep from a dead stop. Avoid: Standing up or swinging from the hips to lift the bar; Dropping the bar to the floor without control; Rounding the back at the start of the pull.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Pike Hold with correct form. Key points: Start in a high plank with hands slightly wider than shoulders; Walk the feet toward the hands and lift the hips high until the body forms an inverted V; Push the shoulders away from the ears, keep the arms straight and the head between them; Hold 20 to 40 seconds while breathing calmly, then return to plank with control. Avoid: Letting the chest and shoulders sink toward the floor; Rounding the lower back instead of lifting the hips; Forcefully locking the elbows.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Prone T Raise with correct form. Key points: Lie face down on a mat with the arms extended out to the sides in a T shape; Rotate the thumbs up and keep the neck in line with the body; Raise the arms off the floor while squeezing the shoulder blades together; Hold one second at the top and lower with control. Avoid: Lifting the head instead of the arms; Using lower back momentum.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Prone Y-T-W Raise with correct form. Key points: Lie face down with the forehead on a folded towel, legs straight and arms extended overhead in a Y; Raise the arms off the floor with the shoulder blades drawn down and thumbs up, and hold one second; Lower, open the arms out to a T and lift again with thumbs up; Lower, bend the elbows into a W and squeeze the shoulder blades, then continue to the next round. Avoid: Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears; Lifting the head and neck off the floor; Using momentum.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Reverse Curl with correct form. Key points: Stand tall and hold an EZ bar with an overhand grip at shoulder width, arms straight; Pin the elbows to the ribs and keep the wrists straight; Bend the elbows and curl the bar to lower chest height; Lower slowly to full extension without loosening the grip. Avoid: Bending the wrists during the lift; Using a heavy weight that forces swinging; Raising the elbows forward.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Reverse Snow Angel with correct form. Key points: Lie face down with legs straight and arms at the sides, palms toward the floor; Lift the chest and arms slightly off the floor and turn the palms out so the thumbs point toward the ceiling; Sweep the arms in a wide arc from the sides to overhead without letting them touch the floor; Sweep back along the same arc to the sides while squeezing the shoulder blades and repeat. Avoid: Lifting the head and cranking the neck; Arching the lower back to lift higher; Resting the arms on the floor mid-arc.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Reverse Wrist Curl with correct form. Key points: Sit on a bench and rest the forearm on the thigh or bench with the hand past the edge, palm facing down; Hold a very light dumbbell with an overhand grip; Raise the back of the hand upward through the full comfortable range of wrist extension; Lower slowly and repeat. Avoid: Using a weight too heavy to control; Lifting the arm off its support; Letting the weight drop fast without control at the bottom.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Ring Push-Up with correct form. Key points: Set the rings 20 to 30 cm above the floor and grip them with the shoulders stacked over them; Get into a high plank, brace abs and glutes and stabilize the rings so they do not swing; Lower the chest between the rings with elbows at about 45 degrees from the body; Push back up and at the top turn the rings slightly outward to deepen the chest squeeze. Avoid: Rings drifting apart on the way down; Sagging hips; Relaxing the shoulders and dropping into the bottom.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Dumbbell Scaption Raise with correct form. Key points: Stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand and angle the arms about 30 degrees in front of the side line of the body; Turn the thumbs up and keep the elbows almost straight; Raise the arms in that plane to shoulder height without hiking the shoulders; Lower slowly and with control to the sides of the thighs. Avoid: A heavy weight that hikes the shoulders; Raising above shoulder height; Swinging the torso for help.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Scissor Kick with correct form. Key points: Lie on the back with hands under the pelvis or at the sides and legs straight; Press the lower back into the floor and raise the legs about 20 to 30 cm off the floor; Open the legs sideways and cross them over each other in a controlled scissor motion, alternating; Keep the abs braced and breathe at a steady rhythm until time is up. Avoid: Lowering the legs too far and arching the lower back; Swinging the legs open fast without control; Lifting the head and neck off the floor needlessly.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Side Plank with Leg Lift with correct form. Key points: Start in a forearm side plank with the feet stacked and the body in one line; Raise the top leg upward with the knee straight and toes pointing forward; Lift to about hip height without letting the pelvis shift or the torso rotate; Lower the leg slowly until it lightly meets the bottom foot; Complete the target reps, then switch sides. Avoid: Hips dropping as the leg rises; Rotating the thigh open and tipping the pelvis backward.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Single-Arm Lat Pulldown with correct form. Key points: Attach a single handle to the high cable, sit or kneel and hold it with one straight arm; Depress the shoulder blade and keep the torso upright and stable; Pull the elbow down toward the ribs until the hand reaches chest height; Pause for one second and squeeze the working lat; Return the hand up slowly and finish all reps before switching sides. Avoid: Twisting and leaning the torso to help the pull; Shrugging the shoulder toward the ear at the start.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Single-Leg Calf Raise with correct form. Key points: Stand on one leg near a wall or rail for light support, with the other foot lifted slightly; Rise as high as possible onto the ball of the foot; Pause for a second at the top without leaning on the support; Lower slowly and finish all reps before switching legs. Avoid: Rolling onto the outside of the foot; Leaning too hard on the wall; Bouncing from the knee.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Sled Push with correct form. Key points: Load the sled with a suitable weight and stand behind it with hands on the handles at mid height; Lean forward in a straight line from the shoulders to the heels, arms almost straight; Drive the floor away in short, powerful steps, extending the knees with every stride; Continue to the end of the lane and bring the sled to a controlled stop before resting. Avoid: Arching the lower back; Taking long steps that lose drive; Rounding the upper back.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Slider Hamstring Curl with correct form. Key points: Lie on your back on a smooth floor with heels on a small towel or sliders and knees bent; Lift the hips into a straight line from shoulders to knees; Slide the heels outward and extend the legs slowly while keeping the hips high; Pull the heels back toward the glutes using the hamstrings. Avoid: Hips dropping as the legs travel out; Sliding too far before you have strength to return; Using the lower back instead of the hamstrings.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Smith Machine Squat with correct form. Key points: Set the bar at shoulder height, get under it and rest it on the upper traps; Step about 20 cm forward of the bar line with feet shoulder-width apart and unhook the bar; Lower under control with a neutral back and knees tracking the toes, to at least parallel; Drive through the whole foot back to standing, and re-hook the bar at the end of the set. Avoid: Feet directly under the bar, driving the knees forward; Rounding the lower back; Not using the safety catches.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Banded Spanish Squat with correct form. Key points: Anchor a strong band to a stable point at knee height and face it with the band behind the knees; Step back until the band is taut, and hold the hands in front of the chest or on a support; Sit back with vertical shins and a tall chest until the knees reach about 90 degrees; Hold the position for the target time while breathing normally, then return to standing under control. Avoid: Unstable anchor so the band releases; Shins tilting forward; Holding the breath during the hold.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Standing Side Bend Stretch with correct form. Key points: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and raise one arm overhead; Rest the other hand on the waist or along the thigh; Bend the torso to the opposite side in a long arc until a stretch is felt along the side of the body; Hold for 20 to 30 seconds with deep breaths, return upright and switch sides. Avoid: Twisting the torso forward or backward while bending; Shifting the hips sideways or bending the knees.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Straight-Arm Pulldown with correct form. Key points: Stand facing the high cable, hold a bar or rope overhand at shoulder width and stand tall with the knees slightly bent; Lean forward at a slight angle with a flat back and arms nearly straight in front of the head; Sweep the bar down in a wide arc to the thighs while the elbows stay softly bent and fixed; Pause for one second and feel the lats contract; Return the bar up slowly until the lats are stretched. Avoid: Bending the elbows and turning it into a triceps pushdown; Swinging the lower back with too much weight.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Sumo Deadlift with correct form. Key points: Stand about twice shoulder width with toes turned out 30 to 45 degrees and the bar over mid-foot; Bend down and grip the bar between the legs with a narrow grip, pushing the knees out over the toes; Lift the chest, brace the abs and set a flat back; Spread the floor apart and stand up with the bar close to the body until knees and hips lock out together; Lower the bar along the same path under control, pushing the hips back. Avoid: Knees caving in during the pull; Hips too low with a rounded back; The bar drifting away from the legs.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Superman Pull with correct form. Key points: Lie face down with arms extended forward and legs straight behind; Lift the hands, chest and legs slightly off the floor, keeping the neck in line with the spine; Pull the elbows back toward the ribs into a W shape while squeezing the shoulder blades; Extend the arms forward with control and keep the lift for the whole set; Lower the body to the floor and rest at the end of the set. Avoid: Cranking the head back and looking forward, which strains the neck; Over-arching the lower back to get higher.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Swiss Ball Hamstring Curl with correct form. Key points: Lie on your back with heels on a swiss ball and arms at your sides; Lift the hips into a straight line from shoulders to heels; Bend the knees and roll the ball toward the glutes while keeping the hips high; Extend the legs slowly without dropping the hips, then repeat. Avoid: Hips dropping as the legs extend; Over-arching the lower back; Ball unstable on a slick surface.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Tempo Push-Up with correct form. Key points: Start in a high plank with hands slightly wider than shoulders and brace abs and glutes; Lower the chest over 3 seconds until it almost touches the floor; Pause for 1 second at the bottom without resting the body on the floor; Drive up hard in 1 second back to straight arms. Avoid: Shortening the descent when the set gets hard; Resting the chest on the floor during the pause; Letting the hips sag from fatigue.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Thread the Needle with correct form. Key points: Start on all fours with shoulders over the wrists and hips over the knees; Lift one hand and thread it under the body toward the opposite side, palm facing up; Lower the shoulder and ear toward the floor gradually and let the rib cage rotate; Pause for a second, then open the hand back toward the ceiling while the eyes follow it. Avoid: Rocking back onto the heels during the movement; Pushing the shoulder into the floor instead of rotating the chest.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Tibialis Raise with correct form. Key points: Stand with your back and glutes against a wall, feet about 30 cm from the wall and hip-width apart; Lift the toes and forefoot up toward the shins while the heels stay on the floor; Pause for a second at the top and feel the muscle at the front of the shin; Lower the foot slowly and repeat. Avoid: Bending the knees to assist the movement; Range too short; Moving too fast.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Towel Isometric Curl with correct form. Key points: Stand tall and place the middle of a long towel under one foot; Hold both ends underhand with the elbows bent to about 90 degrees; Pull the ends upward as if curling without letting the towel move, at roughly 60 to 70 percent of maximal effort; Hold for 10 to 20 seconds, breathe normally, and release gradually. Avoid: Holding the breath and going to maximal effort straight away; Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears; Using a slippery or wet towel that slides off the foot.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Towel Isometric Lat Pull with correct form. Key points: Stand tall holding a long towel in both hands, wider than shoulder width; Raise the towel overhead with the elbows nearly straight; Lower the towel to forehead height while pulling it apart to both sides, as if trying to tear it; Hold the tension for 10 to 20 seconds and keep breathing without letting the shoulders shift; Release slowly and return the arms overhead. Avoid: Shrugging the shoulders toward the ears while pulling; Arching the lower back and flaring the ribs.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing TRX Biceps Curl with correct form. Key points: Hold the TRX handles underhand and lean back with arms extended in front of the body; Move the feet closer to the anchor point to make it harder and keep the body straight from head to heels; Bend the elbows and pull the hands toward the forehead with the elbows staying at shoulder height; Lower under control to straight arms without letting the hips sag. Avoid: Letting the hips sag; Dropping the elbows during the curl; Standing too upright so the move becomes too easy.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing TRX Lat Pull with correct form. Key points: Anchor the TRX straps high, hold the handles and face the anchor point; Lean back with straight arms overhead and the abs, glutes and legs stiff as a plank; Draw the shoulder blades down and pull the elbows down close to the ribs so the body rises toward vertical; Pause for one second with the hands at chest height; Slowly lower the body back until the arms are straight. Avoid: Sagging the hips or arching the lower back; Shrugging the shoulders instead of using the lats.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing V-Sit Hold with correct form. Key points: Sit on the floor with knees bent and hands by your sides; Lean back slightly with a long spine and lift the feet until the shins are parallel to the floor; Reach the arms forward and gradually straighten the legs so the body forms a V; Hold with the chest tall while breathing steadily, then lower with control. Avoid: Rounding the lower back; Holding the breath; Pressing the hands into the floor for support during the hold.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Wall Triceps Extension with correct form. Key points: Stand about one step from the wall and place the palms on the wall at forehead height, roughly 15 cm apart; Brace abs and glutes so the body forms a straight line from head to heels; Bend the elbows and move the forehead toward the wall, keeping the elbows pointing forward rather than flaring; Straighten the elbows and push the body back to straight arms without forcefully locking out. Avoid: Flaring the elbows out to the sides; Folding at the hips and pushing the glutes back.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Wide-Grip Pull-Up with correct form. Key points: Grip the bar overhand 1.5 to 2 times shoulder width with the thumbs wrapped around it; Hang with straight arms, draw the shoulder blades down and brace the abs; Pull the elbows down and out until the chin or upper chest reaches the bar; Lower the body slowly to straight arms without losing shoulder blade position. Avoid: Going so wide that the range shrinks and the shoulders take the load; Pulling with the neck and shoulders instead of the lats.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Wide Push-Up with correct form. Key points: Start in a high plank with the hands about 1.5 times shoulder width apart; Brace abs and glutes and keep a straight line from head to heels; Lower the chest toward the floor with elbows travelling back, not straight out to the sides; Press the floor away back to straight arms without locking the elbows. Avoid: Hands so wide that the shoulder joint is overloaded; Cutting the range of motion short because of the long lever.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Archer Pull-Up with correct form. Key points: Grip the bar overhand very wide and hang with straight arms; Draw the shoulder blades down and start pulling while the body shifts toward one hand; Bend the elbow of the pulling arm while the other arm stays straight along the bar; Pause with the chin level with the working hand, then return slowly to the center; Repeat to the other side and alternate. Avoid: Bending the straight arm and drifting into a normal pull-up; Twisting the torso instead of shifting sideways.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Archer Push-Up with correct form. Key points: Start in a high plank with the hands very wide, about twice shoulder width; Brace abs and glutes and shift the body weight toward one side; Lower the chest toward the working hand while the other arm stays straight with fingers pointing out; Push with the bent arm back to the center and alternate sides. Avoid: Bending the support arm and losing the one-sided load; Twisting the hips instead of shifting the whole body sideways.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Bottoms-Up Kettlebell Press with correct form. Key points: Hold a light kettlebell by the handle inverted with the bell body above the handle at shoulder height and the elbow tucked to the ribs; Grip the handle firmly, keep the wrist straight and brace the abs and glutes; Press the kettlebell straight up with the bell balanced over the hand until the arm is extended; Lower slowly back to the shoulder and switch arms after the set. Avoid: A wrist bent backward; A weight too heavy to balance; Pressing forward in an arc.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Box Jump with correct form. Key points: Stand a short step from a sturdy box with feet hip-width apart; Bend the knees and hips, swing the arms back and load for the jump; Drive hard off the floor and land on the box with both feet, full foot on the surface and knees slightly bent; Stand fully upright on the box and step down one foot at a time instead of jumping down. Avoid: Choosing a box too high before the landing is under control; Jumping down from the box instead of stepping down; Knees collapsing inward on landing.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Broad Jump with correct form. Key points: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes behind the start line; Swing the arms back while pushing the hips back and bending the knees; Drive the floor away and swing the arms forward to jump forward and up at about 45 degrees; Land on both feet together with bent knees and hips back, and stabilize before the next jump. Avoid: Landing with locked knees; Knees collapsing inward on landing; Chaining jumps without stabilizing the landing.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Cable Triceps Kickback with correct form. Key points: Attach a single handle to a low pulley and stand in a split stance with the torso hinged forward and a flat back; Hold the handle and pin the upper arm to the torso, parallel to the floor, with the elbow bent; Extend the elbow to pull the handle back to a straight arm without moving the upper arm; Return under control to about 90 degrees and complete all reps before switching sides. Avoid: Standing up and turning it into a back pull; Resting the stack between reps and losing tension.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Decline Barbell Bench Press with correct form. Key points: Sit on a decline bench, lock the legs under the pads and lie back with shoulder blades pinched; Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders and unrack it with straight arms; Lower the bar under control to the lower chest; Press the bar up to straight arms and rack it at the end of the set. Avoid: Bouncing the bar off the chest; Loading too heavy without a spotter; Flaring the elbows out.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Barbell Good Morning with correct form. Key points: Rest the bar on the upper back as in a squat, unrack and stand shoulder-width with soft knees; Take a breath, brace the abs and squeeze the shoulder blades around the bar; Push the hips back and hinge the torso forward with a flat back until the hamstrings stretch strongly; Drive the hips forward and stand back up while squeezing the glutes. Avoid: Rounding the lower back at the bottom; Bending the knees too much so it turns into a squat; Loading too heavy before the technique is solid.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Hollow Body Rock with correct form. Key points: Get into a hollow body hold: arms straight by the ears, shoulders and straight legs lifted, lower back pressed down; Tense the whole body so it moves as one rigid unit; Rock gently back and forth like a rocking chair, with the upper back and the hips touching the floor in turn; Keep the banana shape through the entire rock and finish with a short hold in the still position. Avoid: Breaking the banana shape and arching the lower back; Rocking with too much uncontrolled momentum; Bending the knees and elbows partway through the set.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Floor L-Sit with correct form. Key points: Sit on the floor with the legs straight in front and the palms beside the hips; Press the floor away, lock the elbows and push the shoulders down away from the ears; Lift the hips and legs off the floor until the legs are parallel to the ground; Hold with braced abs, straight knees and pointed toes, then lower with control. Avoid: Shoulders shrugging up toward the ears; Legs sinking below hip level; Bending the elbows.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Nordic Hamstring Curl with correct form. Key points: Kneel on a soft pad with ankles anchored under a heavy couch or held by a partner; Keep the body straight from knees to head with arms folded in front of the chest; Lean forward slowly without breaking at the hips, resisting the fall with the hamstrings; When you can no longer control it, catch yourself with the hands, push lightly and return to kneeling. Avoid: Breaking at the hips and folding forward; Falling quickly with no resistance; Unstable ankle anchor.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Parallette Deep Push-Up with correct form. Key points: Place the parallettes shoulder-width apart and grip them in a high plank with neutral wrists; Brace abs and glutes and keep a straight line from head to heels; Lower the chest under control below hand height until you feel a comfortable chest stretch; Press back up without losing body tension and finish with straight arms. Avoid: Dropping into the bottom without control; Going deeper than the shoulders can handle; Flaring the elbows out.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Pistol Squat with correct form. Key points: Stand on one leg with the other leg raised straight in front and arms reaching forward for balance; Send the hips back and bend the standing knee while keeping the heel on the floor; Lower under control until the thigh nearly touches the calf, without collapsing onto the heel and keeping the back tall; Press the floor away through the whole foot to stand without help from the free leg, then switch legs. Avoid: Dropping into the bottom; Heel peeling off the floor; Rounding the lower back at depth.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Pseudo Planche Push-Up with correct form. Key points: Start in a high plank with the hands near hip level and the fingers turned out or slightly back; Lean the body forward so the shoulders pass beyond the hands while bracing the abs hard; Lower the chest toward the floor with the elbows close to the body; Push the floor away back to straight arms while keeping the forward lean. Avoid: Leaning forward too far before the joints are conditioned; Letting the belly and lower back sag; Dropping fast without control.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing RKC Plank with correct form. Key points: Start in a forearm plank with elbows slightly ahead of the shoulders and the leg muscles tight; Tuck the pelvis under and squeeze the glutes as hard as possible; Tense the whole body as if trying to drag the elbows toward the feet and the feet toward the elbows; Hold for only 10 to 20 seconds with short, forceful breaths, and stop as soon as tension drops. Avoid: Holding too long as tension fades; Failing to tuck the pelvis and staying with an arched lower back; Holding the breath instead of using short, forceful breaths.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Shrimp Squat with correct form. Key points: Stand on one leg, bend the other leg behind you and grab the foot or ankle with the same-side hand; Keep the torso upright and lean forward slightly, with the standing knee aligned over the foot; Lower the back knee under control until it lightly touches the floor, without sitting on it; Drive through the standing foot back to full standing, then switch legs. Avoid: Dropping the back knee heavily onto the floor; Standing knee collapsing inward; Losing the grip and tipping to the side.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Side-Lying Adductor Raise with correct form. Key points: Lie on your side propped on the lower elbow; Bend the top leg and plant its foot on the floor in front of the bottom leg, keeping the bottom leg straight and in line with the body; Raise the bottom leg upward by squeezing the inner thigh; Lower slowly until almost touching the floor and repeat. Avoid: Lifting too high and rolling the torso; Resting on the floor between reps; Rotating the foot upward.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Sissy Squat with correct form. Key points: Stand with feet together, hold a post or sturdy upright with one hand and rise onto the balls of the feet; Brace the abs and glutes so the body forms a straight line from knees to shoulders; Lean the whole body backward while the knees travel forward, lowering only as far as the knees tolerate, until the body is at a steep backward angle; Return by extending the knees, not by pulling with the back, and lower the heels at the end of the rep. Avoid: Bending at the hips and turning it into a regular squat; Dropping fast with no control; Rounding the lower back.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Svend Press with correct form. Key points: Stand tall and hold two light dumbbells pressed together in front of the chest, palms squeezing the ends; Brace the abs, keep the elbows close to the body and squeeze the dumbbells hard without letting them separate; Press the dumbbells straight forward to nearly straight arms while continuing to squeeze inward; Return slowly to the chest and keep pressure between the dumbbells throughout the rep. Avoid: Letting the dumbbells separate mid-rep; Choosing a weight so heavy it loads the shoulders; Leaning the torso back.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Table Isometric Curl with correct form. Key points: Sit at a sturdy heavy table with the elbow bent to about 90 degrees and the palm facing up; Place the palm under the edge of the table so it touches the underside; Push upward as if curling while the table stays still, building the effort over a second or two; Hold for 10 to 15 seconds at moderate effort, release, then switch sides. Avoid: Using a light table that can shift or tip; Pushing suddenly at maximal effort; Hiking the shoulder instead of using the arm.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Dumbbell Thruster with correct form. Key points: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and two dumbbells at shoulder height with elbows pointing forward; Squat down fully with the chest up and knees tracking over the toes; Drive hard out of the bottom and use the leg momentum to send the dumbbells overhead; Lock out steadily overhead, then lower the weights to the shoulders while sinking into the next squat. Avoid: Pressing with the shoulders only, without leg drive; Arching the lower back at lockout; Squatting too shallow.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Towel Wring with correct form. Key points: Stand or sit holding a rolled towel in both hands at about shoulder width; Twist the two hands in opposite directions as if wringing water out of the towel; Keep twisting until the forearms are working hard and hold for 3 seconds; Release and repeat the wring in the opposite direction. Avoid: Twisting fast without control; Shrugging the shoulders; Using a wet slippery towel that slips from the hands.

Silent seamless 8-second loop, fixed camera, plain studio background, athlete performing Turkish Get-Up with correct form.
